name: bee-ready-spelling
description: Bee Ready spelling practice static site with Kokoro-Piper-device speech fallback

scripts.test: node --check app.js && node --check voice-service.js && node --check sentences.js && node --check stars.js && node --check wordcard.js && for f in mine/*.js tools/library/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check tools/pronunciation/espeak.mjs && python3 -B -c "import ast,sys;[ast.parse(open(f,encoding='utf-8').read(),f) for f in sys.argv[1:]]" tools/pronunciation/asr.py tools/pronunciation/audit.py tools/pronunciation/setup_assets.py && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
